thread:
Maya R.: Quick sync — we need to lock Q2 scope for platform telemetry (dashboards, tracing hooks, cost breakdown, error analytics). Customer asks from beta: per-route cost, tail-latency traces, grouped error signals. Who can join 1pm PT to align?

Carlos V.: I can make 1pm. FYI FinPlatform flagged per-route cost as a gating ask for Dedicated contracts — they'd delay purchase without it.

Leo K.: Heads up on infra: per-route cost needs request tagging at the edge plus token attribution. Full-trace retention for tail analysis will blow ingest. Need rough cost delta before we commit.

Priya S.: My suggestion for tracing hooks: add span tags for route, model, model_version, and user_tier. Default sample rate 0.5%, plus adaptive tail-sampling that captures full traces when latency > p95. Gives visibility for tail without huge spend.

Jenna M.: For Console UX I'd like to ship 3 dashboard templates out of the gate: "Per-route cost", "Latency heatmap by route/model", "Error trends + fingerprint list". Templates should support quick filters and CSV export.

Maya R.: Draft launch criteria (v1):
- Per-route cost metric surfaced in Console (top-20 routes, time-series + CSV export)
- Trace links from sampled high-latency buckets (p90/p95/p99) with span metadata
- Error analytics: grouping (fingerprint), counts, first-seen, impact score (errors affecting X requests)
- Docs, rollout checklist, and canary on Dedicated
- Monitoring/alerts wired to console for regressions
If all meet SLOs, we GA.

Carlos V.: +1. Customer also wants a simple spend-vs-budget per route view in the Console — basically expected vs actual. Can we surface estimated spend in v1?

Leo K.: We can show "estimated" spend in v1 based on token-attribution heuristics (model_token_costs * tokens per request). Accurate SLA-level accounting should be v1.1 because it requires invoice-grade attribution and sampling reconciliation.

Priya S.: Open engineering items:
- Instrumentation SDK change: add route tag + propagation (edge team)
- Trace sampling: implement adaptive tail-sampler and retention policy
- Cost pipeline: enrichment job to attribute tokens -> route/model and roll-up to daily aggregates
- Error analytics: fingerprinting lib + rollup index
I'll draft JIRA tasks after the sync.

Jenna M.: UX open questions:
- How much control do teams need over sample rate? (We can expose slider but default should be safe)
- Dashboard perms: show/hide route cost for tenant admins only?
- CSV schema for export (include model_version, route_id, tokens, estimated_cost)
I'll mock quick screens and post.

telemetry-bot: New ticket created: PLAT-5214 "Per-route cost: Console surface + CSV export" assigned to @Leo K.

Maya R.: Decisions from 1pm: prioritize per-route cost + trace hooks with adaptive sampling for v1. Error analytics v1 = grouped rollups + fingerprints; advanced spend SLA / invoice-grade attribution v1.1. Canaries on Dedicated customers only for first release.

Carlos V.: Copy that. I'll confirm FinPlatform will join the canary cohort and prepare contract notes.

Leo K.: I'll post a short infra estimate (storage + processing) by EOD. Need input on retention defaults (14d vs 30d) — leaning 14d for traces, 90d for rollups.

Priya S.: Agree 14d traces + 90d aggregates to start. We'll add a cost-based retention toggle later.

Maya R.: Thanks all — I'll convert launch criteria into an RFC and share for review tomorrow. :thumbsup:
